name: Cozy Sleeping Bag
description: A used sleeping bag that makes resting a little more restorative.

name: Two Turntables and a Microphone
description: Everyting you need to keep the party going.  Make a bit of extra money every rest from putting on sick nasty EDM shows at your camp, at Leto's chagrin.

name: Groovy Lava Lamp
description: The hypnotic, ever shifting colors of this lamp make you feel luckier.
use_message:
You spend hours staring into the galaxies that this beautiful, tacky lamp puts on display.  Like fireworks on a sunlit sky.  Like flowers blooming on an endless field, like...

You should really lay of that Mystery Powder.

name: Study Desk
description: A tidy desk for reviewing your notes between delves.

name: Shag Wall
description:
Uh... you I guess decided to put up a shag carpet on free standing wall.

It kinda looks like a scratching post.  Might make your claws sharper.

name: Ranch Almanac
description: Well-worn notes on horse care, kept on the mantel.

name: Delicious Turrón
description: A lucky candy from a magical, fantasy land.  You stole this mercilessly and you would do it again if you had the chance.
use_message: You rub the Turrón for luck.  You gain STICKY HANDS.
